summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Proposals for enhancements to the REST specification, such as adding an 'unregister' endpoint and the X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header, are also being actively debated.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes.
Proposal to add X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header to REST spec.
Discussion on efficient column updates and representation of update files.
Spec ambiguity regarding Avro schema for 'day' partition transform fields.
